comment: Bundle size budget in bytes (raw). Two measures, because lazy loading moves code out of the first screen but cannot make the sum smaller. initial = the scripts and styles a first visit downloads before anything is drawn (what index.html names plus the chunks it imports statically); this is what a person waits for and is the tight limit: lower it when it shrinks (npm run size:update), raising it needs a reason in the pull request. total = every script and style file, including each lazy page; it is a generous cap that only catches runaway growth. Before 2026-11-21 the single budget was total only (1,010,000 B of JS, 168,000 B of CSS) and was exceeded by about 100 kB of script after Git hosting, mirrors, rollback and the Learn pages joined, although every page was already a lazy chunk; the first load was about 343 kB of script (react-dom is about half of it) and 131 kB of style. The verification panels were moved out of it (the shell's guide needed only two helper functions from them). Fonts are woff2 files, not counted. The documentation ships as gzipped JSON beside the bundle and is not counted. On 2026-11-21 total_js_bytes went from 1,200,000 to 1,240,000 for the first-run setup guide (one lazy page, about 28 kB, and the QR encoder, about 4 kB, loaded only by the setup page); the initial limit did not move and nothing new entered the first load. On 2026-11-21 (repository browsing) initial_js_bytes went from 347,000 to 350,000: the eight address patterns, their guide text and the Markdown renderer's relative links and pictures are in the first load (the pages, the editor and the syntax highlighter are lazy chunks); total_js_bytes from 1,240,000 to 1,300,000 and total_css_bytes from 190,000 to 197,000 for those pages, the highlighter (about 5 kB) and their styles. On 2026-11-21 (second combined build) the repository pages' addresses, guide text and Markdown pictures had pushed the first load to 349,883 B, over the 347,000 limit; the Guide (its text, the 'coming' texts and the Learn links it shows, about 28 kB) now loads when it is opened, so the first load is 320,900 B and initial_js_bytes went from 347,000 down to 322,000; total_js_bytes is 1,310,000 and total_css_bytes 198,500 for the repository pages and the extra chunk. With feature toggles (second combined build) the first load is 322,861 B (the three toggle addresses are in it, the pages are lazy), so initial_js_bytes is 324,000: still 23,000 below the 347,000 of before; total_js_bytes went to 1,385,000 (measured 1,373,128) and total_css_bytes to 207,000 (measured 205,509) for the toggle pages, their editor and styles. Final measure of the second combined build (with the vocabulary table, the Words page and the code pages): initial 323,523 B of script and 132,133 B of style, total 1,394,973 B of script (limit 1,400,000) and 206,742 B of style. Third combined build (2026-11-21): nine more branches (event log, pull review depth, Debrief, Standing orders, releases, software graph, configuration as code, fleet delivery, live progress) added pages, all as lazy chunks; the first load is 319,317 B of script (the limit stays 324,000: the page titles of the code, images, traffic and changes areas that are not built yet moved out of the first load into their own small file, and the repository and project pages' trails are made by two helpers) and 132,133 B of style. Measured totals: 1,586,811 B of script and 228,024 B of style; total_js_bytes is that plus about 1% (1,603,000) and total_css_bytes 230,500. Release candidate 1 (2026-11-21): work tracking (items, boards, backlog, sprints, charts, agents, settings, the inbox) and organizing (folders, labels, layouts, the Tower sections, explorers, the finder) joined the third combined build, every page a lazy chunk; the first load is 317,533 B of script (limit stays 324,000) and 132,544 B of style. Measured totals: 1,796,002 B of script and 256,682 B of style; total_js_bytes is that plus about 1% (1,815,000) and total_css_bytes 259,500. The rollout page (2026-11-22): the Launch page rides with the run page's chunk, its parts are lazy chunks; the first load is 317,536 B of script (the limit stays 324,000; the branch's own 347,000 is not taken) and 132,544 B of style. Measured totals: 1,845,667 B of script and 264,913 B of style; total_js_bytes is that plus about 1% (1,865,000) and total_css_bytes 267,600. Release candidate 2 final (2026-11-22): the repository pages (settings, Overview, tags, uploads, Security tab), the Depot area and the README tables joined the rollout page; first load 318,587 B of script (limit stays 324,000) and 132,560 B of style; measured totals 1,867,476 B of script and 265,407 B of style; total_js_bytes 1,886,000. Release candidate 3 (2026-11-22): the squadron pages (Add a Squadron, Squadron, Add a Flight, move preview, Organize wizard, tree) joined, all lazy; first load 321,901 B of script (limit stays 324,000) and 132,560 B of style; measured totals 1,925,301 B of script and 270,668 B of style; total_js_bytes is that plus about 1% (1,945,000), total_css_bytes stays 271,000. Release candidate 4 (2026-11-22): narrow credentials (the Who can reach it tab, service accounts, token limits), the release page with its QR code and the outside-host sheet joined, all lazy; first load 322,513 B of script (limit stays 324,000) and 132,560 B of style; measured totals 1,953,161 B of script and 271,919 B of style; total_js_bytes is that plus about 1% (1,973,000) and total_css_bytes 274,500. Notifications and verified commits (2026-11-22): the inbox, notification settings, signing keys, the signature badge and the shell's inbox link joined, all lazy chunks (the link loads after the first screen); first load 323,683 B of script (limit stays 324,000); measured total 1,974,554 B of script; total_js_bytes is that plus about 1% (1,994,000). Release candidate 5 (2026-11-22): the table that says which page a path opens (nav/pages) and the reading of what needs a person (guided/derive) were in the first load and are now lazy chunks, loaded just after the first screen; first load 304,756 B of script (was 323,726 B) and initial_js_bytes went from 324,000 down to 308,000; total_js_bytes stays 1,994,000 (measured 1,983,550). Release candidate 5 final (2026-11-22): chunks under 2 kB are joined into one that loads with them (experimentalMinChunkSize; each chunk carried its own import preamble) and the area launcher loads when first opened; first load 308,895 B of script (was 323,726 B), initial_js_bytes 310,000 (lowered from 324,000); measured total 1,992,559 B of script, total_js_bytes stays 1,994,000 (not raised) after the notification, signing, import and pipeline pages joined. People and access redesign (2026-11-24): the page's cards were drawn as run-on underlined text (a list-item link rule and the in-sentence underline both caught card links); the page now has its own lazy stylesheet (icon, readable description, arrow, who-you-are summary) and reuses the card, grid and tile styles; first load 132,715 B of style (down from 132,727), measured total 275,051 B of style, total_css_bytes 275,500.
